A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PRIMO R1 and provide readable main text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. Added material and relocated or renumbered content can be reliably distinguished.

before.justification: v1 reports original progress-estimation, RoboFail, ablation, training-dynamics and inference-efficiency results in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds specialized-model comparisons and PRIMO R1 results on the external ProgressLM benchmark.

M1.justification: The Qwen2.5-VL-7B backbone, initial/video/current-state inputs, SFT followed by GRPO, and format-plus-accuracy reward remain unchanged. The added evaluations do not introduce a new method component.

E1.justification: Appendix D adds evaluation on the previously unseen ProgressLM benchmark, reporting vision-demo and text-demo subsets. The existing training sources, PRIMO Bench environments and RoboFail task coverage are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 substantially expands the relevant comparator set with VLAC, GVL and Robo-Dopamine-3B/4B. New Table 7 additionally compares against Qwen2.5-VL-32B, Intern3.5-VL-14B/38B and ProgressLM-3B-SFT. The additional ProgressLM row in Table 1 represents the existing model under different inputs, not a distinct new method.

E3.justification: Added Table 1 comparisons use specialized models' recommended input configurations alongside the retained unified protocol. Appendix D introduces zero-shot evaluation without reference demonstrations, NSE/PRC/AFRR metrics and micro/macro aggregation. Settings for retained experiments remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix D adds a targeted cross-benchmark transfer check: whether PRIMO generalizes without fine-tuning or reference demonstrations to an unseen evaluation protocol, including answerable-query rejection behavior. Existing modality and training ablations, error plots and case studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain SFT seed 42, the same plotted error bars and reward-standard-deviation analysis. No new repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance-testing procedures are reported.

E6.justification: Substantial comparison results are added, including ProgressLM's average 78.32 MRA and 20.87 MAE under its recommended inputs, and PRIMO's external-benchmark micro scores of 32.8 NSE, 49.5 PRC and 0.2 AFRR. These are additional experimental conditions, not same-setting gains. Existing PRIMO averages of 82.90 MRA/15.52 MAE and RoboFail accuracy of 67.0% remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The formal task formulation and equations (1)-(5) are unchanged. The newly reported external metrics are named without introducing new mathematical definitions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about process reasoning, temporal anchoring, progress-estimation performance and zero-shot failure detection. Additional benchmark evidence does not redefine these core contributions.

C2.justification: v2 attributes the SFT failure-detection decline specifically to format overfitting, discusses configuration-related differences in specialized-model results, and adds explicit comparability caveats for unequal inputs and reference supervision. Appendix D also introduces interpretations about cross-benchmark transfer and low rejection rates.

D1.justification: The abstract adds a project website pointer. Existing hardware, hyperparameters, data-processing descriptions and prompts are retained, with the experimental-configuration appendix moving from G to H; the PDFs do not establish what downloadable resources the website provides.

R1.justification: v2 adds citations to SFT Memorizes, RL Generalizes and SCIZOR, connecting its findings to format overfitting and limitations of boundary-image-only inputs. Section 2's related-work discussion otherwise remains unchanged apart from citation numbering.

P1.justification: Sections 4.2-4.4 receive localized rewriting and expanded explanations, an external-evaluation appendix and acknowledgements are added, and subsequent appendices are relabeled. The overall narrative and section organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: Table 1 gains a specialized-model block and a comparability caption; external evaluation appears in new Table 7. Existing Tables 2 and 3 exchange numbering/order, Figure 4 moves earlier, and appendix figures and tables reflow without changing their retained content.

improvement.justification: v2 addresses missing relevant baselines and adds an external transfer test, making the empirical claims more assessable while explicitly acknowledging unmatched comparison settings. The gain is limited by incomplete comparator-configuration details and overstated new interpretations: despite claiming superiority over Intern3.5-VL-38B on both averages, Table 7 gives PRIMO worse macro NSE (32.6 versus 30.8) and slightly worse micro PRC (49.5 versus 49.9).
